descriptionChirho: The literal face of a person or animal, including possessive forms (my face, your face, his/her face, their faces), and extended to mean countenance, appearance, or personal presence.

The surface or face of a geographic or physical entity such as the earth, waters, or the deep (e.g., 'the face of the ground', 'the face of the deep'), functioning as a spatial/topographic term rather than a body part.

Spatial preposition meaning 'before, in front of, in the presence of' (primarily in the construction lipne / millipne), including directional 'facing, toward the front' and spatial 'from before / away from the presence of', with Arabic amama, Korean ap-e, Swahili mbele ya as cross-linguistic markers.

Causal preposition meaning 'because of, on account of, due to' (mippene in causal sense), cross-linguistically marked by Arabic bi-sababi, Korean ttaemun-e, Swahili kwa sababu ya, distinct from the spatial 'from before'.

Temporal use meaning 'before, prior to' (a person or event in time) or adverbially 'formerly, in earlier times, of old' (lephanim), cross-linguistically marked by Arabic qabla/qadiman, Korean jeon-e/ijeon-e, Swahili kabla/zamani, distinct from the spatial 'in front of'.
